details.description: A production payment token is hardcoded in source code.
details.fix_explanation: Move secrets to environment variables and configuration management. Do not store production secrets in source code.

details.description: A mail server API key is hardcoded in source code.
details.fix_explanation: Load mail server credentials from secure environment variables or secret manager.

details.description: INTERNAL_AUTH is hardcoded and MD5 is used for hashing authentication tokens.
details.fix_explanation: Move INTERNAL_AUTH to environment and use a secure hash (SHA-256) or HMAC with proper key storage.

details.description: SQL query is built with string interpolation allowing injection via the `id` parameter.
details.fix_explanation: Use parameterized queries with placeholders to prevent injection.
details.secure_code_snippet:
q = "SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?"
c.execute(q, (uid,))

details.description: User-controlled notify_url is called without validation or timeout, enabling SSRF and resource exhaustion.
details.fix_explanation: Validate notify_url to allow only http/https and apply a short request timeout and error handling.
details.secure_code_snippet:
if not is_valid_url(url): abort(400, 'invalid notify_url')
resp = requests.post(url, json={"token": PAYMENT_TOKEN, "amount": amount}, timeout=5)

details.description: update_records reads arbitrary file paths supplied by the user which can leak secrets or allow access to sensitive files.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict files to a configured directory and check resolved path against allowed directory before reading.

details.description: export_data shells out with unsanitized name via `zip` and `shell=True`, allowing command injection and path traversal.
details.fix_explanation: Replace shell command with Python's zipfile module and sanitize the filename to prevent traversal.
details.secure_code_snippet:
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf: zf.write(DB_FILE, arcname=os.path.basename(DB_FILE))

details.description: Flask app is started with debug=True which exposes an interactive debugger and code execution in production.
details.fix_explanation: Always run Flask with debug=False in production and control run parameters via environment/configuration.

details.description: The code prints transfer details which may leak PII or transaction data to logs.
details.fix_explanation: Use structured logging and avoid printing sensitive fields; redact or remove sensitive info.
